text:
emma: Quick heads-up: we're publishing a docs + SDK change for the Python SDK streaming API today. Short version: default streaming now uses chunked frames for better memory and latency characteristics. This is backward-compatible for 60 days via a compatibility flag, then becomes the default, and the legacy `stream=True` boolean will be deprecated in 180 days and removed in 365 days. :loudspeaker:

rafael: Eng notes: implementation landed in sdk-python@v2.8.0. We added `stream_mode` param with values `chunked` or `legacy`. CI will run integration tests for both modes for the next 60 days. We'll also ship a small shim so existing code using `stream=True` continues to work but emits a deprecation warning.

priya: Docs plan: update quickstarts, streaming guide, and the API reference. I'll add a prominent deprecation banner on the Python SDK page and a migration guide with examples. ETA for first draft: tomorrow morning.

oliver: Support playbook requests: please provide a 3-bullet TL;DR and example troubleshooting steps for customers seeing partial payloads. We should also add a note for Dedicated/Private about runtime versions that include the shim.

lina: Sales ask: any customers on call right now who use streaming heavily? I'll surface the 60-day compatibility window in deal notes. Also need a short blurb for customer emails.

rafael: Migration example (for docs):
```python
# legacy
for chunk in client.generate("...", stream=True):
    print(chunk.text)

# new (recommended)
for frame in client.generate("...", stream_mode="chunked"):
    # frame.type in {"partial", "meta", "done"}
    if frame.type == "partial":
        print(frame.text, end="")
    elif frame.type == "done":
        print('\\n--complete--')
```
Notes: chunked frames are smaller, emit explicit meta frames (token counts, partial probs) and reduce memory spikes for long outputs.

emma: Policy/timeline recap:
- Today: docs + SDK patch published, compatibility shim enabled.
- 60 days: legacy `stream=True` stops being the default; `stream_mode` encouraged; warnings become more visible.
- 180 days: `stream=True` deprecated (doc/legal notice + SDK warning).
- 365 days: `stream=True` removed.

priya: I'll create an FAQ: common errors, how to detect legacy consumers, how to toggle `stream_mode`, and config snippet for Dedicated runtime toggles.

docs-bot: Published: docs PR #4286 by priya 1 \"python: streaming mode migration guide (WIP)\" (automated).

oliver: Suggested support TL;DR for internal use: 1) short timeline and safety window, 2) sample migration snippet, 3) how to roll back via `legacy_stream=True` env var on Dedicated. I'll draft and post to support channel.

lina: For customer email: can we get a one-line impact statement + recommended action? e.g., \"No action required for most users; upgrade to sdk-python>=2.8 for improvements. See migration guide.\"

rafael: Ops: For Dedicated/Private, we'll backport the shim to v2.7 runtime images and pin it for 12 months. We'll emit a runtime warning when apps use the legacy boolean.

emma: Thanks all. If you own follow-ups: priya => docs, rafael => SDK shim/CI, oliver => support playbook, lina => customer comms. Ping me if there are high-risk customers. Will post final RFC link once merged. :thumbsup:
